name: au-restructure-rollovers
description: Use this guide to assemble the evidence for, and work the consequences of, three Australian income tax restructure rollovers: the small business restructure roll-over (Subdivision 328-G ITAA 1997), the roll-over for an individual, trustee or all the partners transferring assets to a wholly-owned company (Subdivisions 122-A and 122-B) and the roll-over for interposing a company between a company or unit trust and its members (Division 615). Covers sole traders, partnerships, trusts and companies for 2026-27. Trigger on 'small business restructure roll-over', 'SBRR', 'incorporate my business', 'Div 122', 'interpose a holding company', 'Div 615' or 'restructure rollover'.
